findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. Secrets in source-controlled configuration and Lambda environment variables can be exposed through repository access, Terraform state, or principals able to read function configuration.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. This leaves the function dependent on an unsupported runtime with known or future unpatched vulnerabilities.
